name: CDexAttachmentCodesValueSet
title: CDex Attachment Codes Value Set
description: This set of concepts describes the type of attachments needed to support a claim or prior authorizations. This value set includes LOINC attachment codes and X12's PWK01 Attachment Report Type Code which can be used to support a prior authorization requests.
